description: This Java class defines a JPA entity representing a desktop window, including properties such as position, size, state, payload, and timestamps, along with constructors and getters/setters.

classes.name: DesktopWindow
classes.description: JPA entity representing a desktop window with properties such as position, size, state, payload, timestamps, and session reference.

methods.name: DesktopWindow
methods.description: Constructor to create a new DesktopWindow with specified properties.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: JPA callback to set createdAt and updatedAt timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: JPA callback to update the updatedAt timestamp before updating.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the window.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the session associated with this window.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the session associated with this window.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the window's title.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the window's title.

methods.name: getX
methods.description: Returns the horizontal position of the window.

methods.name: setX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal position of the window.

methods.name: getY
methods.description: Returns the vertical position of the window.

methods.name: setY
methods.description: Sets the vertical position of the window.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the window.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the window.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the window.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the window.

methods.name: getZIndex
methods.description: Returns the z-index (stacking order) of the window.

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Sets the z-index of the window.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state of the window (e.g., 'normal', 'minimized', 'maximized').

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the window.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the JSON payload associated with the window.

methods.name: setPayload
methods.description: Sets the JSON payload for the window.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp.
